minimum_embedded_contract.purpose: Preserve project intent, knowledge, analysis, candidate solutions, decisions, task priorities, provenance and evolution so a new human/AI can continue correctly without prior chat history.
core_rules: Do not infer Product Purpose when owner-confirmed purpose is missing.
Do not silently overwrite parallel/conflicting/historically material knowledge.
Unknown or unavailable facts must remain explicit; never fabricate provenance or priority.
Analysis, Solution, Decision, Requirement, Task, Verification and Acceptance are distinct meanings.
A candidate Solution is not selected without an attributable Decision.
Every new Task carries P0/P1/P2/P3/unassigned; use unassigned instead of guessing.
Priority is not authorization, and priority is separate from execution_order.
Verification is not Acceptance; build/test/runtime success does not itself mean Done where acceptance is required.
No acknowledged material user intent may remain only in conversation history.
An Analysis Overlay advances analysis knowledge without claiming a new software release.
A declared canonical PE store/channel must be read before material mutation.
A stale PE writer must merge rather than overwrite newer canonical state.
